subject: Data Engineering
title: AI in the Data Stack
description: A 60-second lesson on AI in the Data Stack.

hook.text: An analyst types a question in English. The system generates SQL, runs it, and returns a chart. AI meets analytics.

buildup.text: Large language models are being embedded into every layer of the data stack: ingestion, transformation, and BI.

discovery.text: AI can generate dbt models, suggest data quality rules, detect anomalies, and explain dashboard trends.

twist.text: AI-generated SQL can be subtly wrong. Without human review, confident-sounding answers may be inaccurate.

climax.text: AI will accelerate data work but won't replace the need for engineers who understand the data deeply.

punchline.text: AI assists. Engineers verify. Trust requires both.

quiz.question: What is the biggest risk of AI-generated SQL in analytics?
options: It can be subtly wrong while sounding confident
It's always slower than hand-written SQL
AI cannot generate SQL at all
